description_short: Enrich PCAP IPs with context from BigQuery tables.
description_long: Queries a user-specified BigQuery table to enrich all IPs extracted from a loaded PCAP session. Supports configurable field selection via --fields and arbitrary table targeting via --table. Results are stored in the session for automatic injection into pcap_ai_analyzer prompts. Handles batching for large IP sets and graceful fallback when BQ is unavailable.
author: Event Mill Contributors
